encounters.title: Feathers in the Draft
encounters.flavor_text: At the cave mouth, a crow storm-reader sets paper charms into the wind without letting one blow away. She tells Zuzu the cavern remembers spoken bargains more clearly than faces. A cold current keeps returning from the wrong direction.

encounters.title: The Third Shadow
encounters.flavor_text: A guide offers to lead Zuzu underground, but three shadows fall behind her from only two lanterns. She insists the third belongs to a traveler who turned back. At the entrance, a line of stones has been rearranged since sunrise.
